Package index

Pipeline functions

The full set of functions to initialize, start, and check your pipeline. Including setup_environment to interactively start a pipeline for a specific object.

pipeline_init()
Initiate DARApipeline for an EPI pipeline
pipeline_run()
pipeline_run
pipeline_import_for()
pipeline import for
pipeline_status()
Print a status overview of the EPI pipeline
pipeline_vis()
Visualizes object creation as a graph.
setup_environment()
Setup the R environment for creation of objects
pipeline_render_report()
DARA function that renders markdown files
check_last_successful_run()
Check last Successful run
check_most_recent_data()
Check most recent data file within x days

Grab functions

Functions to grab parameters of the current EPI pipeline, such as timestamp, mount, drive name and more.

grab_current_drive_name()
Grab the drive_name for the current EPI pipeline.
grab_object_table()
Grab object_params for all data_assets for the current EPI pipeline.
grab_run_timestamp()
Grab the run_timestamp for the current EPI pipeline.
grab_target_list()
Grab a list of target objects given tag/object filters.
grab_target_mount()
Grab the mount for the current EPI pipeline.

Load and save functions

Including functions to open database connections and get the most file path for the most recent file in a given directory.

get_sp_data()
Retrieves data from a store procedure database within a start and end modification date
load_data()
Load data from specified location and date
most_recent_file()
Return path to most recent file in a directory with given pattern and extension
open_tbl_con()
Creates an active dbplyr tbl connection to a database
save_cache()
Save an object to the cache directory
save_data()
Save data
save_output()
Save an object as output

Copy functions

Functions used to copy files and paths to and from copy locations.

copy_asset()
Copy single asset
get_copy_from_file_path()
Get the copy from file path from object_definitions
get_copy_to_dir_path()
Get the copy to dir path from object_definitions

Other functions

idle()
Idle
mark_for_refresh()
Mark data_assets for refresh
